items.title: Flip Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996
items.q: My cousin, Frank Reed... I sort of looked up to him... he bought me this clarinet... he told me if you want to play the saxophone, start on the clarinet

ctx.x: I’ve read something about your career, you started on clarinet?

Yeah. That was my first instrument. My cousin, Frank Reed, who was an excellent musician, was a saxophone player and clarinet. And I sort of looked up to him and he bought me this clarinet for ten dollars you know, in 1927. And it was just wonderful. I started on that and he told me if you want to play the saxophone, start on the clarinet because that’s a good foundation for you and the saxophone will come easier to you, which it did you know.
